{{Top|leg}}
An '''adrenaline booster''' was a medical substance that administered [[Adrenaline/Legends|adrenaline]] to a patient. In combination with [[stim-shot]]s, the boosters kept patients alert and prevented the onset of shock. Adrenaline boosters could be found in [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]], and could also be released directly into a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]], or injected into the patient using retractable [[hypospray]]s.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
